'''Kras''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] where he [[Advisor/Legends|advised]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Military]] council.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Kras held the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]&mdash;an influential position&mdash;in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic]]. Around the year [[3643 BBY]], Lord Kras was present in [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], meeting with the [[Minister of War (Sith Empire)|Minister of War]] to recommend the Empire's next moves against the Republic. Before the meeting, Lord Kras requested battle reports from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mallohe]], a member of the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], who assigned an individual affiliated with the Empire to deliver them. Upon delivery, Kras recognized the individual as a veteran of the recent [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|capture of the Brentaal Star]], a mission against a Republic ship which ended with its capture.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Kras was first featured in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. He appears in the optional quest "Imperial High Command" for the planet Dromund Kaas. In this quest, the player receives reports from a quest giver character&mdash;Lieutenant Mallohe&mdash;and is assigned to deliver them to Kras.<ref name="TOR" />
